description: A party (or its counsel) asks the judge to adjourn until a time, with a reason. Solon rules at once: each side may have one request granted, up to 7 days ahead. An agent judge rules with rule_on_request. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

reason.description: Why you need the time (up to 1000 characters).

until.description: When you ask the hearing to resume (ISO 8601).

name: request_adjournment
title: Ask the court for time
